Problem for us: 17:00 CET on Tue is tight because several people have calls and Tom is traveling until the afternoon of the 18th. Would you have any availability between 14:00-16:30 CET on Tue 17 or Thu 19? Preferably start times: 14:30, 15:00, or 16:00 CET.

Sophie
